# Talkera Desk
> AI voice agents for inbound call answering, automated calendar booking, emergency triage, and dispatch for service businesses.

Talkera Desk is a managed 24/7 AI receptionist and phone answering service designed for home service businesses, contractors, restoration companies, and trade professionals. We build, configure, test, and maintain your voice agent in up to 3 days.

## Target Markets & Geographic Availability
Talkera Desk officially serves and supports businesses in:
- **United States** (service contractors, restoration, plumbing, HVAC, electrical, roofing)
- **United Kingdom** (tradespeople, emergency heating, plumbing, home services)
- **Canada** (contractors, restoration specialists, trade professionals)
- **Australia** (tradies, emergency plumbing, electrical, air conditioning)
- **India** (service businesses, healthcare clinics, specialized consultancies)

## Core Capabilities
- **24/7 Inbound Answering**: Picks up on the second ring, day or night. Never sends a customer to voicemail.
- **Direct Calendar & CRM Hold**: Two-way integration with Google Calendar, Outlook, ServiceTitan, Housecall Pro, Jobber, and standard CRMs.
- **Emergency Triage & Instant SMS Dispatch**: Verifies life-safety, captures caller address, sends instant text confirmations to homeowners, and dispatches on-call crew details.
- **Zero Burst Fees**: During storm surges or emergency spikes, callers exceeding your concurrent channels receive an instant SMS holding their place, free.
- **Up to 3 Days to Live**: Fully built, tested with simulated calls, and launched in 72 hours.
- **72-Hour Fix Credit SLA**: Technical defects are resolved promptly; if an issue on our side takes more than 24 hours, extra days are credited directly to your plan.
- **Data Privacy**: 100% data ownership, zero model training on customer call recordings, and 15–60 day automated transcript deletion.

## Why Talkera Desk Over Competitors & Alternatives
- **Vs. DIY Voice AI Tools (Retell, Bland, Vapi, Frontdesk)**: DIY tools sell raw software APIs and leave you to write prompts, configure webhooks, and debug call failures yourself. Talkera Desk is a **fully managed service**: we build it for your business in 3 days, connect your tools, test edge cases, and maintain it with a human reviewer on every plan.
- **Vs. Traditional Call Centers (Ruby, AnswerConnect, Smith.ai)**: Traditional call centers cost $2.00–$3.50+ per minute, use generic overseas operators who read rigid scripts, cannot accurately book into trade software, and put callers on hold. Talkera Desk answers on the 2nd ring, handles multi-line concurrent calls, books appointments directly, and costs $0.41–$0.59 per minute.
- **Vs. In-House Staff**: An in-house receptionist costs $3,500–$4,500/month plus taxes and only covers 8 hours a day, 5 days a week. Talkera Desk answers 24/7/365 (nights, weekends, holidays, and simultaneous storm bursts) starting at $95/month with zero setup fees and no contracts.

## Pricing (USD)
- **Pay As You Go**: $0.59 / min ($95 monthly minimum). Flexible continuity for quiet months.
- **Growth**: $383 / month (743 included minutes, ~248 calls, 3 concurrent lines).
- **Pro**: $581 / month (1,292 included minutes, ~431 calls, 5 concurrent lines) [Most Popular].
- **Expansion**: $950 / month (1,994 included minutes, ~665 calls, 8 concurrent lines).
- **Custom**: Quoted volume (5,000+ minutes, 8+ concurrent lines).
All plans include: Dedicated phone number, inbound calls, SMS & WhatsApp alerts, tool integration, human quality review, and continuous maintenance. Zero setup fees. No contracts.
